title: Mobile-MMLU: A Mobile Intelligence Language Understanding Benchmark
findings: The benchmark includes 'Religious Studies' as one of its 80 topics. This topic was rated as having 'Low-Medium Relevance' for mobile use cases with a score of 4.38 out of 10. It was also identified as one of the 20 most challenging topics for the models tested, with an average accuracy of 0.574 across models.
